t.Avant même de penser à votre site, à la: Before you even think about your website, advertising or social media, there's a free tool every tradesperson, shop owner or independent professional should have: the Google Business profile.
t.Elle s'appelle aussi Google Business Pro: It's also called Google Business Profile, or formerly Google My Business. Whatever the name — it's the same thing, and it's often the fastest way to show up on Google.
t.Qu'est-ce que la fiche Google Business ?: What is a Google Business profile?
t.C'est la fiche qui s'affiche quand quelq: It's the listing that appears when someone looks for a professional near them. It contains your name, your business, your address, your opening hours, your phone number, your photos and your customer reviews.
t.Elle apparaît dans Google Maps et dans l: It appears in Google Maps and in the "local pack" — the block of 3 results with a map shown at the very top of Google for local searches. This block appears before regular websites. It's often the first thing your future customer sees.
t.87 % des consommateurs utilisent Google: 87% of consumers use Google to find a local provider. And a complete profile gets up to 7 times more clicks than an empty or incomplete one.
t.Autrement dit : ne pas avoir de fiche, o: In other words: having no profile, or a poorly filled-in one, means sending customers to your competitors — even if your work is better.
t.Comment créer votre fiche en 5 étapes: How to create your profile in 5 steps
t.Connectez-vous avec un compte Google (Gm: Sign in with a Google account (Gmail is enough). Click "Manage now".
t.Nom exact de votre entreprise, catégorie: The exact name of your business, business category, address or service area, phone number, and website if you have one.
t.Google vous enverra un courrier avec un: Google will send you a letter with a verification code. This usually takes 5 to 14 days. Once verified, your profile is live.
t.Des photos réelles de vos réalisations,: Real photos of your work, your workshop or your team. Profiles with photos get far more clicks. For tradespeople, before/after photos are particularly effective.
t.Étape 5 — Demandez vos premiers avis: Step 5 — Ask for your first reviews
t.Contactez vos clients satisfaits et dema: Contact your happy customers and ask them to leave a Google review. Reviews directly affect your position in the results. Reply to all your reviews, positive and negative alike.
t.Une fiche créée une fois et jamais mise: A profile created once and never updated loses its effectiveness. Google favours active profiles. A few simple habits: update your opening hours, add photos regularly, reply to reviews quickly.
t.Ce n'est pas une contrainte — c'est 15 m: It's not a chore — it's 15 minutes a month that can make a real difference to your incoming enquiries.
t.Et si vous ne savez pas par où commencer: And if you don't know where to start?
t.Votre site reçoit des visiteurs. Mais vo: Your website gets visitors. But your inbox stays empty. Your phone doesn't ring.
t.Ce n'est pas une question de chance. C'e: It's not a matter of luck. It's a matter of design. Your website isn't convincing visitors to take action.
t.Voici les 5 raisons les plus fréquentes: Here are the 5 most common reasons — and what you can do to fix them.
t.Un visiteur qui arrive sur votre site a: A visitor landing on your website has about 5 to 8 seconds to understand what you do and whether it's for them. If it isn't immediately clear, they leave.
t.Le problème est souvent le même : des te: The problem is often the same: generic copy ("welcome", "quality", "professionalism") that says nothing specific about your business or what you actually deliver.
t.La correction : votre phrase d'accueil d: The fix: your opening line should answer three questions in one sentence. Who you help. To do what. With what result.
t.Erreur n°2 : On ne sait pas comment vous: Mistake #2: People don't know how to contact you
t.Cela semble évident. Et pourtant, c'est: It seems obvious. And yet it's one of the most common mistakes. The contact form is hidden at the bottom of the page. The phone number only appears on the "contact" page.
t.La correction : votre numéro de téléphon: The fix: your phone number and contact button should be visible on every page, at the top, without anyone having to look for them.
t.Erreur n°3 : Votre formulaire est trop l: Mistake #3: Your form is too long
t.Chaque champ supplémentaire réduit le no: Every extra field reduces the number of people who fill in your form. Last name, first name, phone, email, subject, message, CAPTCHA... At some point, the visitor gives up.
t.La correction : simplifiez. Nom, email,: The fix: simplify. Name, email, message. That's often enough for a first contact.
t.Erreur n°4 : Il n'y a pas de raison d'ag: Mistake #4: There's no reason to act now
Your website presents your business well. But it gives no reason to contact you today rather than tomorrow. And "tomorrow" often means never.
t.La correction : ajoutez un élément qui r: The fix: add something that makes the first step feel safe. "Free first conversation, no commitment." "I reply within 24 hours." "No hidden fees." These simple phrases remove the last hesitations.
t.Erreur n°5 : Votre site n'inspire pas co: Mistake #5: Your website doesn't inspire trust
t.Un visiteur qui ne vous connaît pas a be: A visitor who doesn't know you needs reassurance before contacting you. If your website looks dated, the photos are poor quality or the copy is full of mistakes, they hesitate.
t.La correction : des photos professionnel: The fix: professional photos, visible customer reviews, an "about" page that shows your background. These elements build trust before the very first contact.
t.Comment savoir ce qui bloque sur votre s: How do you find out what's blocking your website?
t.Vous avez fait créer votre site. Vous êt: You had your website built. You're proud of the result. And yet, when you type your trade into Google, you don't show up. Your competitors do.
t.Ce n'est pas une question de chance. C'e: It's not a matter of luck. It's a matter of method.
t.Raison n°1 : Google ne sait pas ce que v: Reason #1: Google doesn't know what you do
t.Google lit votre site comme un robot. Il: Google reads your website like a robot. It looks for specific words to understand your business. If your copy says "welcome to my website" and "quality and professionalism", Google can't tell whether you're a plumber, a consultant or a florist.
t.Ce qu'il faut faire : écrire clairement: What to do: write clearly who you are, what you do, who for, and in which area. In the simple words your customers type themselves.
Example: "I'm an electrician in Lyon. I work for homeowners and tradespeople across the Rhône on electrical installation, compliance upgrades and repairs."
t.Raison n°2 : Votre site n'est pas optimi: Reason #2: Your website isn't optimised for mobile
t.Depuis 2021, Google classe les sites en: Since 2021, Google ranks websites primarily on their mobile version. If your website is hard to read on a phone — text too small, buttons too close together, slow loading — Google penalises it.
t.Plus de 60 % des recherches locales se f: Over 60% of local searches are made from a smartphone.
t.Ce qu'il faut faire : tester votre site: What to do: test your website on mobile. If it's hard to read or navigate, fix that first.
t.Raison n°3 : Vous n'avez pas de fiche Go: Reason #3: You don't have a Google Business profile
t.La fiche Google Business est gratuite. E: A Google Business profile is free. It lets you show up on Google Maps and in local results — often even before regular websites.
t.Sans elle, vous n'existez pas sur les re: Without one, you don't exist for searches like "electrician near me" or "plumber Lyon 3rd arrondissement".
t.Ce qu'il faut faire : créer votre fiche: What to do: create your profile at business.google.com, fill it in completely, and ask your happy customers to leave a review.
t.Raison n°4 : Votre site est trop récent: Reason #4: Your website is too new
t.Google prend du temps à faire confiance: Google takes time to trust a new website. The first results usually appear 3 to 6 months after launch — provided the website is well built from the start.
t.Ce qu'il faut faire : investir ce temps: What to do: use that time to set up your Google profile properly, publish useful content, and get mentioned on other websites.
t.Raison n°5 : Vos concurrents ont pris de: Reason #5: Your competitors got a head start
t.Si des concurrents sont bien positionnés: If competitors have ranked well for years, it takes time to catch up. But it's not impossible — especially on specific local searches where competition is often low.
t.Ce qu'il faut faire : viser des mots-clé: What to do: target specific keywords rather than generic ones. "Electrician Lyon 7th" is far more achievable than "electrician Lyon".
t.Un site bien visible sur Google, c'est d: A website that's highly visible on Google means customers who find you without you having to look for them. It's your website working for you, even when you're on a job or in a meeting.
t.C'est une des questions les plus fréquen: It's one of the most common questions among independent professionals and tradespeople starting out. Should you build a website first? Or focus on Facebook, Instagram or LinkedIn?
t.La réponse honnête : les deux ont leur u: The honest answer: both are useful. But they don't do the same thing.
t.Les réseaux sociaux servent à vous faire: Social media helps you get known, show your work and build a closer relationship. It works well for visual businesses and for people who post regularly.
t.Le problème : la visibilité d'un post du: The problem: a post stays visible for 24 to 48 hours. Then it disappears. You have to post constantly to exist. And you depend on the algorithms of a platform you don't control.
t.Autre point important : les réseaux soci: Another important point: social media mostly reaches people who already follow you. It's hard to reach new customers who don't know you yet.
t.Un site web, c'est votre adresse sur int: A website is your address on the internet. It belongs to you. It doesn't disappear if a platform changes its rules.
t.Surtout, un site bien conçu vous permet: Above all, a well-designed website lets people who don't know you yet find you — through Google. These people are actively looking for your service. They intend to buy. They're often the easiest customers to convince.
t.Un article ou une page bien positionnée: An article or page that ranks well on Google can keep bringing you enquiries for months, without you having to do anything more.
t.Ce que nous recommandons selon votre sit: What we recommend for your situation
t.Ce n'est pas \"site ou réseaux sociaux\": It's not "website or social media". It's "what will bring me customers regularly and sustainably?"
t.Les réseaux sociaux apportent de la visi: Social media brings short-term visibility. A well-built website brings long-term customers. The two complement each other — but if you have to choose where to start, start with the basics.
